description: This file declares the SimpleBufferPool class, which manages memory buffers, providing methods for allocation, deallocation, and shared buffer management. It includes private data members for buffer management and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: SimpleBufferPool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of memory buffers, providing thread-safe allocation and deallocation methods.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Template method to allocate a buffer for a specified number of elements of type T.

methods.name: allocateShared
methods.description: Template method to allocate a shared pointer managing a buffer for a specified number of elements of type T.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Method to deallocate a buffer pointed to by a void pointer.

methods.name: allocateImpl
methods.description: Private method that performs the actual memory allocation for a given number of bytes.
